title_en: NASA’s Neil Gehrels Swift Observatory reenters over Western Indonesia
summary_en: NASA’s Neil Gehrels Swift Observatory plummeted back into Earth’s atmosphere Wednesday over western Indonesia, ending nearly 22 years in orbit for the gamma-ray burst hunter after a failed attempt to rescue it.

title_en: NASA’s Neil Gehrels Swift Observatory to burn up this week after more than two decades in space
summary_en: As of Monday, the U.S. Space Force predicted Swift would re-enter Earth's atmosphere at approximately 3:30 a.m. EST Wednesday, Nov. 4, somewhere within about 21 degrees north or south of the equator — a band that is mostly ocean.

title_en: NASA nears end of space station solar array upgrade with Oct. 29 and Nov. 5 spacewalks
summary_en: NASA is two spacewalks away from completing a major, years-long upgrade to the International Space Station that will power the orbiting lab through to its planned decommissioning in 2030.
